parameters.value: export default async function ({ page, context = {} }) {   const origin = 'https://www.blu-ray.com';   const userId = String(context.userId || 'YOUR_BLURAY_USER_ID');    let cookies = context.cookies || [];    if (typeof cookies === 'string') {     try {       cookies = JSON.parse(cookies);     } catch {       throw new Error(         'Invalid cookie JSON in Edit Fields: cookie_dvd. Paste the complete JSON array.'       );     }   }    if (!Array.isArray(cookies)) {     throw new Error('Cookies must be a JSON array.');   }    const validCookies = cookies     .filter(cookie =>       cookie.name &&       /(^|\.)blu-ray\.com$/i.test(         cookie.domain || 'www.blu-ray.com'       )     )     .map(cookie => ({       name: cookie.name,       value: String(cookie.value ?? ''),       domain: cookie.domain || '.blu-ray.com',       path: cookie.path || '/',       secure: cookie.secure !== false,       httpOnly: Boolean(cookie.httpOnly),     }));    if (validCookies.length) {     await page.setCookie(...validCookies);   }    await page.setViewport({     width: 1280,     height: 900,   });    await page.setExtraHTTPHeaders({     'Accept-Language': 'fr-FR,fr;q=0.9,en;q=0.8',   });    async function visit(url, selector) {     await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 500));      const response = await page.goto(url, {       waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded',       timeout: 60000,     });      if (!response || response.status() >= 400) {       throw new Error('Page unavailable: ' + url);     }      await page.waitForSelector(selector, {       timeout: 20000,     });   }    await visit(     origin + '/community/userstats.php?u=' + userId,     '.cloud'   );    const stats = await page.evaluate(() => {     const clean = value =>       String(value || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();      const tiles = {};      for (const card of document.querySelectorAll('.cloud')) {       const count = card.querySelector('b');       const label = card.querySelector('div');        if (count && label) {         tiles[clean(label.textContent)] = Number(           count.textContent.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '')         );       }     }      const link = [       ...document.querySelectorAll('a[href*="picture="]'),     ].find(a => clean(a.textContent) === 'TV series');      const text =       link?.closest('h2')?.parentElement?.textContent || '';      const series = text.match(       /([\d,\s]+)\s+of\s+[\d,]+/i     );      if (       !['DVD', 'Blu-ray', 'Films'].every(key =>         Number.isInteger(tiles[key])       ) ||       !series     ) {       throw new Error(         'Statistics could not be read. Check the session and page structure.'       );     }      return {       DVD: tiles.DVD,       'Blu-ray': tiles['Blu-ray'],       Films: tiles.Films,       Series: Number(         series[1].replace(/[^0-9]/g, '')       ),     };   });    const releases = new Map();    for (const categoryId of [7, 21]) {     for (const action of ['owned', 'wishlist']) {       const base =         origin +         '/community/collection.php?u=' + userId +         '&categoryid=' + categoryId +         '&action=' + action;        const queue = [base];       const visited = new Set();        while (queue.length) {         const url = queue.shift();          if (visited.has(url)) continue;          if (visited.size >= 500) {           throw new Error(             'Pagination limit reached: ' + base           );         }          visited.add(url);          await visit(url, 'h2.oswaldcollection');          const result = await page.evaluate(           ({ categoryId, action }) => {             const heading = document.querySelector(               'h2.oswaldcollection'             );              const form = document.querySelector(               '#selectionform'             );              if (               !form &&               !/\b0\s+SKUs?\b/i.test(                 heading?.textContent || ''               )             ) {               throw new Error(                 'Collection entries could not be read.'               );             }              const section = form               ?.querySelector('h2')               ?.textContent.trim()               .toLowerCase();              if (               section &&               ['owned', 'wishlist'].includes(section) &&               section !== action             ) {               throw new Error(                 'The requested collection view was not loaded.'               );             }              const rows = [               ...(form?.querySelectorAll(                 'a.hoverlink[data-productid][href]'               ) || []),             ]               .filter(a =>                 Number(a.dataset.categoryid) === categoryId               )               .map(a => ({                 id: a.dataset.productid,                 url: a.href,                 title:                   a.title ||                   a.querySelector('img')?.alt ||                   '',               }));              const pages = [               ...document.querySelectorAll(                 'a[href*="page="]'               ),             ].map(a => a.href);              return { rows, pages };           },           { categoryId, action }         );          for (const row of result.rows) {           const link = new URL(row.url);            if (             link.origin !== origin ||             !/^\/(movies|dvd)\/[^/]+\/\d+\/?$/.test(               link.pathname             )           ) {             throw new Error(               'Unexpected release URL: ' + row.url             );           }            const key =             categoryId + ':' + row.id + ':' + action;            releases.set(key, {             ...row,             categoryId,             action,           });         }          for (const href of result.pages) {           const link = new URL(href, base);            if (             link.origin !== origin ||             link.pathname !== '/community/collection.php'           ) continue;            if (link.searchParams.has('letter')) continue;            const expected = {             u: userId,             categoryid: String(categoryId),             action,           };            const changesView = Object.entries(expected).some(             ([key, value]) =>               link.searchParams.has(key) &&               link.searchParams.get(key) !== value           );            if (changesView) continue;            const number = link.searchParams.get('page');            if (/^\d+$/.test(number || '')) {             const next = base + '&page=' + number;              if (               !visited.has(next) &&               !queue.includes(next)             ) {               queue.push(next);             }           }         }       }     }   }    const collection = [];   const cache = new Map();    for (const release of releases.values()) {     if (!cache.has(release.url)) {       await visit(release.url, 'h1');        const details = await page.evaluate(         ({ categoryId }) => {           const clean = value =>             String(value || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();            const headings = [             ...document.querySelectorAll('.subheading'),           ];            function sectionText(heading) {             let text = '';              for (               let node = heading?.nextSibling;               node;               node = node.nextSibling             ) {               if (                 node.nodeType === 1 &&                 node.matches('.subheading')               ) break;                text += ' ' + (node.textContent || '');             }              return clean(text);           }            const title = clean(             document.querySelector('h1')?.textContent           );            const metadata = clean(             document.querySelector('h1')               ?.closest('table')               ?.nextElementSibling               ?.textContent           );            const infoHeading = document.querySelector(             '#movie_info h3'           );            let infoType = '';            for (             let node = infoHeading?.nextSibling;             node;             node = node.nextSibling           ) {             if (node.nodeName === 'BR') break;             infoType += ' ' + (node.textContent || '');           }            const isTvMovie = /\bTV (movie|film)\b/i.test(             metadata + ' ' + infoType           );            const seriesMetadataPattern =             /\b(seasons?|episodes?|TV (mini[- ]?)?series)\b/i;            const seriesTitlePattern =             /\b(seasons?\s+\d|(?:first|second|third|fourth|fifth|sixth|seventh|eighth|ninth|tenth|final|complete)\s+season|complete (original )?series|mini[- ]?series|episodes?\s+\d+\s*[-–]\s*\d+)/i;            const isSeries = !isTvMovie && (             seriesMetadataPattern.test(metadata) ||             seriesTitlePattern.test(title)           );            if (             /\(TV\)/i.test(infoType) &&             !isSeries &&             !isTvMovie           ) {             throw new Error(               'Ambiguous TV type; series or TV movie: ' + title             );           }            if (!infoHeading) {             throw new Error(               'Release information not found: ' + title             );           }            const discsHeading = headings.find(             h => clean(h.textContent) === 'Discs'           );            const discs = sectionText(discsHeading);           const formats = [];            const isUhd =             /\b4K\b|Ultra\s*HD|\bUHD\b/i.test(discs || title);            if (isUhd) {             formats.push('4K Ultra HD');           }            let remaining = discs.replace(             /(?:4K\s*(?:Ultra\s*HD)?|Ultra\s*HD|UHD)(?:\s+Blu-ray(?:\s+Discs?)?)?/gi,             ''           );            if (/Blu-ray\s*3D|3D\s*Blu-ray/i.test(remaining)) {             formats.push('Blu-ray 3D');              remaining = remaining.replace(               /Blu-ray\s*3D|3D\s*Blu-ray/gi,               ''             );           }            if (/Blu-ray/i.test(remaining)) {             formats.push('Blu-ray');           }            if (/\bDVD\b/i.test(discs)) {             formats.push('DVD');           }            if (!formats.length) {             formats.push(               categoryId === 21 ? 'DVD' : 'Blu-ray'             );           }            const priceCell = document.querySelector(             '#movie_buylink, #dvd_buylink'           )?.closest('td');            const priceHeading = [             ...(priceCell?.querySelectorAll(               '.subheading'             ) || []),           ].find(             h => clean(h.textContent) === 'Price'           );            const priceText = sectionText(priceHeading);            const match = priceText.match(             /\bNew from:\s*(?:€|EUR)\s*([\d][\d.,\s]*)/i           );            let price = null;            if (match) {             let amount = match[1].replace(/\s/g, '');              const separator = Math.max(               amount.lastIndexOf(','),               amount.lastIndexOf('.')             );              if (               separator >= 0 &&               amount.length - separator - 1 <= 2             ) {               amount =                 amount.slice(0, separator).replace(/[.,]/g, '') +                 '.' +                 amount.slice(separator + 1);             } else {               amount = amount.replace(/[.,]/g, '');             }              const value = Number(amount);              if (Number.isFinite(value) && value >= 0) {               price = Math.round(value * 100) / 100;             }           }            return {             Genre: isSeries ? 'série' : 'film',             Categorie: formats.join(' + '),             Prix: price,           };         },         { categoryId: release.categoryId }       );        cache.set(release.url, details);     }      const title = release.title       .replace(         /\s+\(\d{4}(?:\s*[-–]\s*\d{4})?\)\s*$/,         ''       )       .trim();      if (!title) {       throw new Error(         'Missing title: ' + release.url       );     }      const details = cache.get(release.url);      collection.push({       Titre: title,       Genre: details.Genre,       Statut:         release.action === 'owned'           ? 'dans ma bibliothèque'           : 'liste de souhait',       Categorie: details.Categorie,       Prix: details.Prix,     });   }    return {     data: {       statistiques: stats,       collection,     },     type: 'application/json',   }; }
